label: Professional services and intermediaries estate
domain: lobbying, legal, consulting, audit, placement, registered-agent, compliance, and public-affairs intermediaries
scope: The firms and individuals that translate between capital, public authority, regulation, transactions, and institutions: lobbying registrants, foreign agents, law firms, consultancies, auditors, placement agents, registered agents, compliance providers, and named engagement teams. The estate distinguishes legal representation, lobbying, advisory work, filing agency, and operational control.

asset_refs.role: bounded frontier survey and acquisition preparation

boundary: A shared adviser, law firm, registered agent, or lobbying firm is an intermediary overlap only. It does not establish coordination, common control, knowledge, influence, or causation.

next_acquisition.operation: resolve intermediary engagements to exact client, matter, date, legal entity, and service type
next_acquisition.decisive_output: engagement ledger separating lobbying, legal representation, audit, placement, registered-agent, consulting, and compliance roles with explicit ordinary-client controls
